name: Royal High-Road

features.name: Gold Respin
features.description: Coin respins with a 5,000x Royal jackpot.

features.name: Storybook theme
features.description: A hero's journey with a king and princess.

review:
A fairy-tale journey on 25 lines, with forest sounds and gently melancholic music – it's prettier and sadder than you'd expect from a slot.

The key feature is Gold Respin: coins trigger a respin round where you try to fill the grid for the Royal jackpot worth 5,000x. Same idea as Gold Rush – Johnny Cash and Grand Mustang, so pick this one for the storybook theme. Very high volatility, 5,624x max and 96.14% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
author: editorial-team
